title: Miracle in Milan
creator: Vittorio De Sica
description: Original title Miracolo a Milano. Vittorio De Sica’s postwar fable, written with Cesare Zavattini: a kind orphan leads a shantytown against a greedy landowner. It ends with the poor flying on broomsticks over Piazza del Duomo, the cathedral square.

title: Maria by Callas
creator: Tom Volf
description: Tom Volf’s documentary tells soprano Maria Callas’s life in her own words, from interviews, letters and home movies. La Scala, Milan’s opera house, was the centre of her career in the 1950s, when she and director Luchino Visconti staged operas there.

title: Rocco and His Brothers
creator: Luchino Visconti
description: Luchino Visconti’s drama about a widow and her five sons who move from the poor south to Milan during the 1950s boom. It runs nearly three hours. Its darkest scene was shot on the shore of the Idroscalo, a rowing lake by Linate airport.

title: La Notte
creator: Michelangelo Antonioni
description: Michelangelo Antonioni follows a novelist (Marcello Mastroianni) and his wife (Jeanne Moreau) through a day and night as their marriage runs down. It opens on the glass face of Gio Ponti’s new Pirelli Tower skyscraper. It is slow by design.

title: Teorema
creator: Pier Paolo Pasolini
description: Pier Paolo Pasolini’s allegory: a mysterious young guest (Terence Stamp) upends each member of a rich Milan factory owner’s family. The owner hands his factory to the workers and ends up stripping naked in Milano Centrale, the main railway station.

title: Piazza Fontana: The Italian Conspiracy
creator: Marco Tullio Giordana
place: Piazza Fontana, site of the agricultural bank
description: Original title Romanzo di una strage. Marco Tullio Giordana on the 12 December 1969 bombing of an agricultural bank on Piazza Fontana, a square behind the Duomo, which killed 17. The courts later blamed a neo-fascist cell. No one was punished.

title: House of Gucci
creator: Ridley Scott
description: Ridley Scott’s drama from Sara Gay Forden’s book, with Lady Gaga as Patrizia Reggiani and Adam Driver as Maurizio Gucci, whom she had killed in 1995. He was shot on the steps of his office at Via Palestro 20, a street along the public gardens.

title: I Am Love
creator: Luca Guadagnino
description: Original title Io sono l’amore. Luca Guadagnino’s drama about a rich Milan textile family, with Tilda Swinton as the Russian-born wife who falls for a young chef. The family home is Villa Necchi Campiglio, a 1930s villa now run as a house museum.
